W56

Discussion setup and moderation

/teach/courses/:courseId/discussions/:discussionId/manage
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: follow-onLegacy: S11

Create course/group discussion spaces and moderate specific contributions with clear audience and preserved history.

Entry and return
W30 staff manage discussionW31 report/moderate actionW35 communication
Layout regions
SetupPrompt, audience, open/close and posting rules
Moderation queueReported post excerpt, reason, actor/role and review status
Action historyLock/hide/restore decisions with learner-visible explanation

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Hide contribution
  • Post author/time, selected excerpt and reason
  • Reporter identity stays restricted; original preserved for authorised review
Return without applying changesHide with recorded reason
Permissions
  • Instructor publishes discussion setup and defines moderator scope.
  • TA moderation requires explicit current course/group scope and end time; grading allocations alone grant no moderation right.
  • Group discussions follow membership permissions and never become private messaging.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Every post shows author, role and timestamp; audience is visible before posting.
  • Locking a thread removes reply controls for learners without deleting contributions.
  • TA cannot moderate another group by changing route IDs; failed action leaves post unchanged.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
